c74object.name: evi_korgms10
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
c74object.description:
evi_korgms10 is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_korgms10.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_tanh.genexpr, evi_sources.genexpr, evi_interp.genexpr
evi_korgms10 is also available in MSP as: evi.korgms10~.
The 'Korg 35' chip was found in the MS-10 and early MS-20 synthesisers - different to the later dual-amplifier Korg OTA chip found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: Input. Audio input to be filtered.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: Frequency in Hz. Filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @default 0.72. Filter resonance 0..1. As in the original analog circuit, lowpass output level is resonance dependent!

attribute.name: noiselevel
attribute.description: Amplitude level of gaussian noise recirculation in filter, 0..1 remapped 0.. 10% of gaussian level. Adding noise is not required for self oscillation, but for sound design.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: If on (1) the filter is 2x oversampled. If off (0, the default), the filter runs at samplerate. Oversampling is recommended to deal with the nonlinear behaviour of the filter, but is expensive because of the multimode outputs.
